key_concepts: Sand has the largest particles among soil types
Clay has the smallest particles among soil types
Loam is a mixture of clay and sand
Particle size affects how well soil drains water
Sand drains water quickly and holds little water
Clay drains water poorly and holds much water
Loam holds enough water and is best for most plants
Sand has a coarse or grainy texture
Clay has a fine texture and feels sticky when wet
Clay can become hard as stone when dry
Sand is used as a growing medium for cactus
